tools.name: lookup_uen
tools.description: Look up one Singapore company by its UEN (Unique Entity Number). Returns name, status, type, registration date, industry, address, officer count and former names from ACRA.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search Singapore companies by current or former name. Optional filters: SSIC industry code, postal code, live only.

tools.name: new_companies
tools.description: List companies registered in Singapore in the last N days before the latest data date, optionally for one SSIC code.
